title: I Edited This Entire Video With AI (No Premiere, No Final Cut)
description:
This entire video was edited with AI — no Premiere, no Final Cut. I just talked to Claude.

Here's the workflow:
🎙️ Phone shoots the clips
🔊 AI normalizes the audio to YouTube standards + strips out wind/background noise
🎬 Remotion merges the clips and builds the transitions
📝 Whisper transcribes everything, then auto-places the text overlays at the right moments

It's part of how I'm building passive income — maximizing my time with tools that are available to everyone and aren't hard to learn.

👉 Every tool I use is listed on my site, and the full breakdown is in the article:
🔗 https://neo-pioneer.com/articles/ai-video-editing-claude-remotion

#AIvideoEditing #Claude #Remotion #Whisper #PassiveIncome #ContentCreation #AItools #Shorts
